runner.rerun: every executed case, in a fresh container

notMeasured.reason: Cancelling a running job is not exercised: the harness runs the factory step by step, not as a whole job.
Timings come from a benchmark runner, not from production. Runs on an emulated runner are slower than production.
Room-study proposals are graded on the typed proposal and honesty only, and are left out of the verified-artifact count.
Steel cases are not in plumb-v1.
